body:
Pink Cobaltian Calcite in tumbled form is exceptionally rare. This small batch was sourced from a single Tucson Gem Show vendor known for producing limited, high-quality runs. We hand-selected each piece to ensure its beauty and energetic softness.

This stone carries a deeply loving and compassionate vibration, supporting emotional healing on a gentle yet powerful level. It helps release grief, sadness, and emotional weight stored in the heart.

Pink Cobaltian Calcite encourages self-love, acceptance, and inner peace. It softens the edges of emotional pain, allowing you to feel supported, held, and safe.

This is a stone for those needing comfort, healing, and reconnection to love—both within themselves and in their relationships.

Rare and nurturing, it’s a reminder that healing can be soft, supportive, and transformative.
